original_text: <!-- (Audio) Expert: Another thing: don't skip breakfast. Breakfast gives you the energy to start the day. If you skip it, you probably compensate later by eating too much or you feel sluggish in the morning. Have a balanced breakfast instead. -->
translated_text: <!-- (Audio) Ekspert: Još nešto: ne preskačite doručak. Doručak vam daje energiju da započnete dan. Ako ga preskočite, verovatno ćete kasnije kompenzovati tako što ćete previše jesti ili ćete ujutru osećati letargiju. Umesto toga, pojedite uravnotežen doručak. -->
